overview: I’m documenting my homelab: a hands-on environment for networking practice and testing, with a virtualization platform for self-hosted services. This is a tour of my equipment and how it connects. Setup guides, troubleshooting, and lessons learned live on the blog.

equipment.description: ISP equipment providing the fiber connection to the home network. Detailed setup documentation has not been recorded.

The primary household router remains in place, with the Cisco lab behind the existing home network so lab configuration changes do not disrupt household connectivity. A summarized route for the lab networks will be added to the home router after the C1111 is installed.
equipment.photoAlt: My Netgear Nighthawk RAX45 home router

equipment.description: The planned lab router will connect the existing home network to the Cisco lab. The first implementation uses router-on-a-stick: the C1111 will provide Layer 3 routing and a default gateway for each lab VLAN, while the 3560CX initially operates primarily at Layer 2. Router configuration has not begun.

Inspected and validated through console access before configuration. Hardware, interfaces, IOS, licensing, and PoE were verified. Hostname and baseline configuration, VLAN creation, management SVI, management access port, and SSH preparation are complete. GigabitEthernet0/9 is reserved as the planned 802.1Q trunk toward the C1111.
specifications: 8 × Gigabit Ethernet PoE+ access ports · 240W available PoE budget
2 × additional Gigabit copper uplink interfaces · SFP uplink capability

equipment.description: My compact homelab virtualization and server platform runs Proxmox VE as the bare-metal hypervisor and hosts a Debian virtual machine used as the primary Docker host.
equipment.photoAlt: My HP EliteDesk 800 G6 Mini homelab server

configuration.name: Current progress
configuration.details: I’m developing two parts of the lab: physical Cisco networking and server/virtualization infrastructure. The switch baseline is configured and the EliteDesk software stack is running; C1111 routing and dedicated lab VLAN integration remain planned.

configuration.name: VLAN plan and switch configuration
configuration.details: The VLANs are configured on the switch with the subnet-level design below. Each VLAN will receive its default gateway from the C1111. Device management will occur over SSH once routing is in place.

configuration.details: The first implementation uses router-on-a-stick, with the 3560CX primarily at Layer 2. The router uplink and home-to-lab routing remain planned; the full topology is not yet operational.

topology.alt: Provisional topology: Internet → Fiber ONT → Nighthawk RAX45 home router → Cisco C1111-4P lab router → Cisco Catalyst WS-C3560CX-8PC-S switch → HP EliteDesk 800 G6 Mini server and future lab devices. Household computers and IoT devices branch from the RAX45. The C1111 has not arrived; lab uplinks and routing remain planned.
topology.caption: The physical Cisco lab is now being configured. The router-to-switch uplink and connection to the home network are planned and will be completed after the C1111 arrives. The full topology is not yet operational; household computers and IoT devices continue to connect through the Nighthawk RAX45.
